purpose: Long-term acceptance fixture derived from public optical catalog references; not a copy of a user project, job, request or checkpoint.
one_time_comparison: Selected public optical records were compared to the diagnostic input and matched exactly for kind, units, domain and n/k arrays or parameters; no private identifiers or private arrays included.
hash_scheme: UTF-8 JSON ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators comma/colon, no NaN, one trailing newline; optical projection contains only present keys kind,wavelength_unit,wavelength_min,wavelength_max,wavelengths,n,k,parameters.

environment.assumption_scope: H-K9L substrate has no k; assume only unknown k zero; preserve known film k and do not extrapolate.
environment.initial_state_note: Seedless public fixture reflects the adapted diagnostic request, not a copy or reconstruction of the private exported project layers; substrate is double-sided while back coating remains empty.

measurement.threshold_note: Nominal cap is 0.0065; saved binary float serializes as 0.006500000000000001. Comparisons are inclusive.

reference_search_settings.notes: External cooperative turn cancel at 600 seconds; no hard real-time guarantee. Archive capacity is not a physical layer cap; unrelated UI structure_options 32/2000 are not active synthesis constraints.

acceptance_contract: Preserve original pointwise inclusive T objectives, geometry and explicit absorption assumptions.
Continuation must not replace a more favorable independently audited incumbent with a worse terminal candidate; validate with a controlled public/synthetic fixture, not a private checkpoint.
For pointwise-only restoration, reject clearly dominated candidates only using fresh dense evidence beyond incumbent and guard; potentially better or near-tie candidates receive complete audit.
At duplicate conditions canonical dense values own dense points; extra-only duplicate observations retain worst violation.
No claim of target attainment, material infeasibility, continuous certification, trajectory equivalence or production performance follows from this declarative case alone.

When search_until_target is true and an outer structural frontier remains, a completed local session with unmet goals must not terminate the outer search prematurely; known open policy defect remains unresolved in .09.
